group.harbor.entry.line.content: Basic particles: continuous snow with a single spark burst. Next, compare the weather presets.
group.harbor.entry.shader-intro.content: Now I’ll show five scene-post visual effects one at a time. Blur uses horizontal and vertical Gaussian passes; the ShaderToy demos use a plain color stage.
group.harbor.entry.shader-bloom.content: Bloom is the first shader example in this chapter. Observe the soft glow spreading inward from the bright windows, then compare blur.
group.harbor.entry.shader-blur.content: Blur uses a separable Gaussian with five iteration bands and 15 dense taps in each horizontal and vertical pass. Its 28-pixel radius softly diffuses the scene.
group.harbor.entry.shader-toy-tunnel.con: ShaderToy sample: an animated procedural fog tunnel.
group.harbor.entry.shader-toy-grid.conte: ShaderToy sample: an animated, perspective 3D grid.
group.harbor.entry.shader-toy-rain.conte: ShaderToy sample: a raymarched rainy road with reflections.
group.harbor.entry.demo-cue-route-blinds: Next: watch a blinds transition into the filled route.
